description: Header file defining the Queue class used in QUIC test tools simulator, implementing a finitely sized packet queue with aggregation features.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: A finitely sized packet queue with aggregation capabilities, used in QUIC simulator.

classes.name: ListenerInterface
classes.description: Interface for listening to queue events such as packet dequeuing.

classes.name: AggregationAlarmDelegate
classes.description: Alarm delegate for handling aggregation timeout events.

methods.name: Queue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the queue with simulator, name, and capacity.

methods.name: set_tx_port
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for the queue.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the queue.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs queue actions, such as dequeuing packets.

methods.name: EnableAggregation
methods.description: Enables packet aggregation with specified threshold and timeout.

methods.name: NextBundle
methods.description: Advances to the next aggregation bundle, flushing current packets.

methods.name: ScheduleNextPacketDequeue
methods.description: Schedules the next packet dequeue operation.
